description: S4 -- adapter over the EXISTING score_scanner/premarket_momentum_score.py. These params are passed straight into that module's own ScoreScannerConfig; they are its current defaults, restated here so section 19 holds (parameters in a file) without editing the existing scanner. Changing a value here changes what this adapter asks for, never what the standalone score scanner does when run on its own.

parameter_meanings.min_score: The wrapped scanner's own 0-100 score floor. Its scoring is 50 base, +20 for breaking the prior high, +10 for ADX over the threshold, +10 for being at or near the 52-week high.
parameter_meanings.min_premarket_gain_pct: (latest intraday price / prior daily close - 1) * 100. 7.0 means the name must already be up at least 7%.
parameter_meanings.min_volume_multiple: latest bar volume / rolling 20-bar average intraday volume. Strictly greater than 2.0.
parameter_meanings.adx_threshold: Daily 14-period ADX. Strictly above 25.0 earns the bonus; it is a scoring input, not a hard filter, inside the wrapped scanner.
parameter_meanings.week52_high_proximity_ratio: Fraction of the 52-week high that price must reach to count as at/near it: price >= week52_high * 0.98, i.e. within 2% of the 52-week high. Passed to the wrapped module's `near_52w_ratio` field, whose name this key deliberately does not copy -- a bare 0.98 in a report tells a reader nothing.
parameter_meanings.avg_volume_window: Bars in the rolling intraday average-volume window.
